title: Cinderborn: The Conclave Trials
description: Turn-based hex strategy: a lowcaste imposter fights through a rigged trial of noble houses

title: Green Circle TD
description: Maze tower defense: creeps circle in from four corners to the center, passing every position. TRUE ONLINE MULTIPLAYER (2-4 players): WC3-style lobby with 4-letter room codes, authoritative server, per-player build zones, a shared overrun meter. v3 ports the real WC3 map's mechanics, decompiled from the original: leaks are RECOVERABLE — a creep that gets past you keeps circling and killing it takes its weight back off the meter; a flattened armour matrix with DIVINE walls on waves 5/13/21/27 where Chaos (Void) does 20x the damage of anything else; tower DOWNGRADE to recover misallocated gold; and the full 30-wave armour schedule published up front so you can plan the build. Plus procedural turret + creep graphics, Lv1-3 upgrades and 3-way specializations, auto-advancing waves (Space to stack early), air-targeting restriction, distinct creep archetypes, local hot-seat co-op, aura towers, Mint economy tower, interest economy, 1x/2x/3x speed, and 30 waves to a multi-phase boss.

title: Iron Meridian
description: Cold-war alternate-history RTS built to parity with the 1996 Westwood classic: ore economy, construction-yard base building, two factions with full ground, air and naval rosters, superweapons, fog of war, 28-mission campaign, skirmish AI on 16 maps, saves, replays, and peer-to-peer lockstep multiplayer. Original factions, art, and audio.

title: Ironmarch
description: Warcraft-1-style real-time strategy. Command the Human Alliance against an Orc Horde AI: harvest gold and lumber, build a base (Town Hall, Farm, Barracks, Blacksmith, Guard Tower), train Peasants, Footmen, Archers and Knights, scout under fog of war, and destroy the enemy base before their raiders destroy yours.

title: Line Tower Wars
description: Standalone web Line Tower Wars, inspired by the Warcraft 3 custom map — build a maze, leak creeps to your opponent.

title: OpenWar
description: An open reimplementation of the 1994 orcs-versus-humans real-time strategy game. Playable straight away; load your own DATA.WAR for the original artwork, sound and all 24 campaign missions.

title: Pokémon Speedrun Gen 1
description: Voice-first (tap fallback) Gen 1 Pokémon speedrun. Name all 151 as fast as you can.

title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: a 20-mission four-act campaign with a branching Seal/Harness choice, 3 mechanically distinct factions, a prerequisite-gated tech tree with stacking research, buildable superweapons (Ion Cannon / Resonance Device), a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep. v0.56 GAMEPLAY OVERHAUL: real RA-pace economy (tier 2 ~1 min, tier 3 ~2-3 min), 15-25 minute matches on a 48x48 map with contested expansions, three true AI difficulty personalities that build bases, expand, retreat and play behind fog-of-war, an RA-style win condition (no more hunting the last rifleman), and the full 24-unit / 23-structure roster reachable from a paged data-driven sidebar. v0.63 ARMY FEEL: a selected group marches at its slowest member's pace (WC3 group movement — the hero no longer reaches the enemy alone), units pick targets their weapon is good against instead of whatever is nearest, radar pings and an EVA "Unit lost" line for field losses, and scripted camera beats glide instead of cut. v0.64 MODERN DISPLAY: fills any widescreen window with sharp high-DPI rendering and more visible battlefield, loads a fraction of the data, adds soft fog, a selection panel with one-click army and control-group access, a settings screen with rebindable keys and fullscreen, and touch controls for tablets.

title: Tank You Again
description: Real-time multiplayer tank arena. 8-way movement, fuel-as-health, landmines, masked radar, 10-tier rank ladder.

title: Tower Wars
description: Maze tower defense with income/sends, hero towers, and large-map pan/zoom control.

title: Shard Dominion v2
description: Classic sci-fi RTS on Aether Prime — bake-off build 3, from the Hermes Execution Manifest v2.0 (veterancy, hazard zones)

title: Shard Dominion: Chat Version
description: Classic sci-fi RTS on Aether Prime — bake-off build 2, from the chat-version build package

title: Shard Dominion: Fable
description: A real-time strategy game where you harvest Aether Shards and expand your dominion across a procedurally generated world.

title: Tower Wars II
description: Branching tower upgrades, balanced enemy waves, and a fresh take on maze TD.
